end.parentNote: Asha practised timelines and sources of history, including inscriptions, coins, books, and other evidence. Aarav engaged with examples of ancient kings, walls, and photographs. They continued to say that books alone give the full truth; this mix-up was not corrected after it was last seen. At home, compare one event using a book, an inscription, and a coin, and discuss what each source can and cannot tell us.
